title: Aim Mark Infinite Pack
description: A minimalist Minecraft resource pack that adds a smooth infinite-style aim mark to block textures for a cleaner and more focused gameplay experience.
body:
# Aim Mark Infinite Pack
A minimalist Minecraft resource pack that adds a smooth infinite-style aim mark to block textures for a cleaner and more focused gameplay experience.
Features
# Infinite-style centered aim marker
Clean and minimalist visual design
Vanilla-friendly appearance
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Smooth alignment on block textures
# Improves visual precision while building or aiming
Perfect For
PvP players
Precision builders
Minimalist Minecraft setups
Players who enjoy clean visuals
Content creators and montage videos
Style
This pack preserves Minecraft’s original aesthetic while adding a subtle modern targeting effect directly onto blocks.
The infinite-style mark blends naturally with gameplay without making textures feel overloaded.
Compatibility
Compatible with most Minecraft Java Edition versions that support resource packs.
Installation
Download the resource pack
Move the .zip file into your resourcepacks folder
Open Minecraft
Go to Options → Resource Packs
Enable the pack and enjoy the new visual style
Notes
Designed for players who want a subtle visual aiming reference and a unique infinite-style texture experience without heavily modifying the vanilla look.
